name: Sales Invoice New Billing
script:
total = 0
total_discount = 0
total_cgst = 0
total_sgst = 0

for item in doc.items:

    qty = item.qty or 0
    mrp = item.custom_mrp_ or 0
    discount_per = item.discount_percentage or 0
    cgst_per = item.custom_cgst_ or 0
    sgst_per = item.custom_sgst_ or 0

    gross = qty * mrp
    discount = gross * discount_per / 100
    amount = gross - discount

    cgst = amount * cgst_per / 100
    sgst = amount * sgst_per / 100

    item.amount = amount
    item.custom_discount_amount = discount
    item.custom_taxable_value = amount
    item.custom_cgst_amount = cgst
    item.custom_sgst_amount = sgst

    total += amount
    total_discount += discount
    total_cgst += cgst
    total_sgst += sgst

doc.total = total
doc.custom_overall_discount = total_discount
doc.custom_cgst = total_cgst
doc.custom_sgst = total_sgst
doc.custom_total_gst = total_cgst + total_sgst

# Grand Total = Total + Total GST
doc.grand_total = total + total_cgst + total_sgst
doc.rounded_total = round(doc.grand_total)

script:
inpatient_record = frappe.form_dict.get("inpatient_record")
 
if not inpatient_record:
    frappe.response["message"] = []
else:
    ip = frappe.get_doc("Inpatient Record", inpatient_record)
    services = []
 
    # -----------------------------------------
    # LAB INVESTIGATIONS
    # -----------------------------------------
    for row in ip.lab_test_prescription:
        if not row.lab_test_code:
            continue
        template = frappe.get_doc("Lab Test Template", row.lab_test_code)
        if not template.item:
            continue
        rate = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Item Price",
            {"item_code": template.item, "selling": 1},
            "price_list_rate"
        ) or template.lab_test_rate or 0
        services.append({
            "type": "Investigation",
            "item_code": template.item,
            "item_name": template.lab_test_name,
            "qty": 1,
            "rate": rate
        })
 
    # -----------------------------------------
    # PROCEDURES
    # -----------------------------------------
    for row in ip.procedure_prescription:
        if not row.procedure:
            continue
        template = frappe.get_doc("Clinical Procedure Template", row.procedure)
        if not template.item:
            continue
        rate = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Item Price",
            {"item_code": template.item, "selling": 1},
            "price_list_rate"
        ) or 0
        services.append({
            "type": "Procedure",
            "item_code": template.item,
            "item_name": template.template_name,
            "qty": 1,
            "rate": rate
        })
 
    # -----------------------------------------
    # THERAPIES (covers Rehabilitation sessions too)
    # -----------------------------------------
    for row in ip.therapies:
        if not row.therapy_type:
            continue
        therapy = frappe.get_doc("Therapy Type", row.therapy_type)
        if not therapy.item:
            continue
        rate = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Item Price",
            {"item_code": therapy.item, "selling": 1},
            "price_list_rate"
        ) or 0
        services.append({
            "type": "Therapy",
            "item_code": therapy.item,
            "item_name": therapy.therapy_type,
            "qty": 1,
            "rate": rate
        })
 
    # -----------------------------------------
    # ROOM CHARGES
    # -----------------------------------------
    for occ in ip.inpatient_occupancies:
        if not occ.service_unit:
            continue
 
        service_unit_type = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Healthcare Service Unit",
            occ.service_unit,
            "service_unit_type"
        )
        if not service_unit_type:
            continue
 
        item_code = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Healthcare Service Unit Type",
            service_unit_type,
            "item"
        )
        if not item_code:
            continue
 
        item_name = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item_code, "item_name") or item_code
 
        rate = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Item Price",
            {"item_code": item_code, "selling": 1},
            "price_list_rate"
        ) or 0
 
        # qty = number of days occupied (check-in to check-out, or till now if still admitted)
        check_in = frappe.utils.get_datetime(occ.check_in)
        check_out = frappe.utils.get_datetime(occ.check_out) if occ.check_out else frappe.utils.now_datetime()
 
        total_seconds = (check_out - check_in).total_seconds()
        days = int(total_seconds // (24 * 60 * 60))
        if total_seconds % (24 * 60 * 60) > 0:
            days = days + 1
        if days < 1:
            days = 1
 
        services.append({
            "type": "Room Charge",
            "item_code": item_code,
            "item_name": "Room Charge - " + item_name + " (" + occ.service_unit + ")",
            "qty": days,
            "rate": rate
        })
 
    frappe.response["message"] = services

name: Bill Summary Payment Intergration
script:
bill = frappe.get_doc("Bill Summary", frappe.form_dict.bill_summary)

if not bill.customer:
    frappe.throw("Customer is mandatory.")

pe = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")

pe.payment_type = "Receive"
pe.company = bill.company
pe.posting_date = bill.date

pe.party_type = "Customer"
pe.party = bill.customer

# Accounts
pe.paid_from = "Debtors - SH"
pe.paid_to = "Cash - SH"

# Currency
pe.paid_from_account_currency = "INR"
pe.paid_to_account_currency = "INR"

# Exchange Rate
pe.source_exchange_rate = 1
pe.target_exchange_rate = 1

# Amount
pe.paid_amount = bill.total
pe.received_amount = bill.total

# Reference
pe.reference_no = bill.name
pe.reference_date = bill.date

pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.response["message"] = pe.name

Sales Invoice GST Calculation
script:
total_cgst = 0
total_sgst = 0

for tax in doc.taxes:
    account = str(tax.account_head or "").upper()
    amount = float(tax.tax_amount or 0)

    if "CGST" in account:
        total_cgst += amount

    elif "SGST" in account:
        total_sgst += amount

doc.custom_cgst = round(total_cgst, 2)
doc.custom_sgst = round(total_sgst, 2)
doc.custom_total_gst = round(total_cgst + total_sgst, 2)
